related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.work_intent_alignment_status: the persisted WorkIntent predates the current environmental capability campaign objective
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment Session.invoke, selected-worktree preflight, and operation-scoped checkout lock

request.fixture: two independent Environment session objects invoke a mocked provider against one actual temporary linked Git worktree

outcome.interpretation: This exercises actual file creation through Session.invoke in an isolated temporary linked worktree. The provider executor remains a test double, so this does not establish behavior of an external provider, independent-agent discovery, lower coordination overhead, or conflict reconciliation for overlapping edits.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Manifest verification commands cannot execute under session authority in dirty/foreign checkouts
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment provider effect eligibility and verification
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The source pressure registry records a prior dirty/off-branch verification invocation that required a persistent claim and fell back to direct tests. This test verifies a claimless Environment invocation path on a selected linked worktree; it does not repeat the historical agent encounter.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one prior session in the source registry; cross-session system recurrence is not established
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use current writable rights, exact selected-worktree identity, a fresh preflight, and bounded operation-scoped serialization for Environment-mediated effects without requiring persistent component ownership.
